metrics.justification: No personal court or anti-corruption matter of record. A 2009 matter involved her then political secretary, not her, and produced no charge against her; it is single-source and treated as unverified background, not recorded against the subject.

metrics.justification: On the Jana Wibawa discharge-not-amounting-to-acquittal of a politician (4 Nov 2025), she explained on the record the legal basis (withdrawal under the Criminal Procedure Code, the public prosecutor's constitutional discretion). Transparent explanation of a process she does not control, with continued parliamentary criticism; mixed (anchor 2).

citation.title: Azalina explains why Adam Radlan freed by court in Jana Wibawa case

metrics.justification: Carried the Parliamentary Services Act 2025 through (passed 5 Mar 2025, royal assent 14 Jul 2025), restoring Parliament's administrative autonomy; but the flagship Attorney-General / Public Prosecutor separation reached only a Cabinet decision (Sep 2025, amendment targeted for 2026) and the Ombudsman and Political Financing bills remained pre-tabling. One major reform delivered, others pending (anchor 3).

citation.title: Dewan Rakyat passes Parliamentary Services Bill, reviving abolished legislation

metrics.justification: The Parliamentary Services Act 2025 restores Parliament as an autonomous service separate from the executive civil service, a concrete strengthening of the legislature and the separation of powers. Documented institution-building (anchor 3).

citation.title: Dewan Rakyat Passes Parliamentary Services Bill, Parliament To Gain Autonomy

metrics.justification: On the citizenship constitutional amendments she co-led, two contested provisions affecting foundlings and abandoned children were withdrawn (Mar 2024) after public feedback, explained on the record; but the climb-down was announced primarily by the co-leading Home Minister and was partial, so candor is shared (anchor 2).

citation.title: Government drops plan to deny automatic citizenship to foundlings, stateless children
